name: Dyson Air
author: Chris Pagolu
description: Control Dyson purifiers, fans, heaters and humidifiers from the Omarchy bar, through Home Assistant.

barWidget.description: Speed, heat, oscillation, night mode and air quality for a Dyson device.

schema.label: Number shown in the bar
schema.description: Fan speed is hidden while the device is off, since a speed with nothing running reads as stale.

schema.label: Poll interval when every panel is closed (seconds)
Treat as stale after (seconds)
schema.description: A live Dyson reports continuously, so silence this long means Home Assistant has lost the device.

schema.label: Reconnect automatically when stale
schema.description: Presses the integration's reconnect button, at most once every two minutes.
